name: feature-workflow
description: Directory-based feature lifecycle: capture (idea.md) → plan (plan.md) → ship (shipped.md), with status by file-presence, an orthogonal state overlay (active/paused/replaced/abandoned), epics, a dependency graph, and an auto-generated DASHBOARD.md. Reviews run through a provider-agnostic channel — a local Claude subagent by default (no CI, no API keys), or GitHub / Bitbucket PRs, or none. Adapted from Court Schuett's feature-workflow plugin: file model + engine ported intact; the GitHub-Actions/Gemini/Codex review path replaced by the pluggable review-channel seam.
